label: sec:photonic-hall-data
html:
Existing data sets.

  • Frequency-encoded photonic Chern insulator measurements of Chenier et al. [chenier2026].
  • Many-body interference data in kagome lattices [guo2025].
  • Chiral phonon experiments in rare-earth halides [luo2023].

Planned observations.

  • Extension of photonic Chern insulator experiments to tunable q-regimes via lattice-geometry variation.
  • Fractional quantum Hall experiments in synthetic photonic systems with controllable topology.

Potential new experiments.

  • Measurement of Hall conductance in photonic lattices at varying effective q parameters. This seeks the 1 - q^{-1} correction predicted by the quantum Planck constant.
  • Cold-atom realisations of \mathrm{SU}(2) gauge fields in optical lattices. This tests the q-deformed braiding statistics of Chapter.
